function.name: osu_ai_status
function.description: Shows what the osu! AI player is doing now: which room it is in, its difficulty level, whether it is ready for the current map, whether it is playing, and its last result.

function.name: osu_ai_list_rooms
function.description: Lists the open lazer multiplayer rooms on the osu! server, so the AI can be sent into one.

function.name: osu_ai_join_room
function.description: Sends the AI player into a lazer multiplayer room. It gets ready on its own once it has prepared the room's current map (about 10-30 seconds), then plays every round the host starts.

room_id.description: Room ID, from osu_ai_list_rooms or the room's link.

password.description: Room password, if the room has one.

level.description: How strong the AI plays. expert is its best (about 99% accuracy).

function.name: osu_ai_leave_room
function.description: Takes the AI player out of its current room.

function.name: osu_ai_set_level
function.description: Changes how strong the AI plays, from the next round on.

function.name: osu_ai_play_map
function.description: Has the AI play one beatmap on its own (not in a room) and returns its accuracy, rank, score, combo, judgement counts and a replay download link. Takes about 10-30 seconds.

beatmap_id.description: Beatmap (difficulty) ID on the osu! server.

mods.description: Mods as lazer APIMod objects, e.g. [{"acronym": "HD"}]. The AI was trained without mods, so expect it to do worse with HR or DT.
